decisions.reason: Setting the subject-field placeholder to Danish does not resolve or change the separate document default-language requirement.
The source specifies placeholder content for the subject field, not the uniqueness or content relationship of persistent control labels.
The source changes placeholder wording but does not change how or when placeholder text clears.
The specified subject text does not alter the field implementation mechanism or architecture.
Subject-field placeholder text is unrelated to bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The source supplies field-specific text and does not change the required style catalog or its template-set coverage.
A Danish subject placeholder does not change style prefixes, style-name language, or naming coverage.
The field-specific text decision does not alter supported Word versions or reliability expectations.
The subject-field placeholder has no effect on multi-digit numbered-list alignment.
The source changes textual content only and does not modify the required theme color palette.
The subject placeholder wording does not change legacy-content paste behavior, test files, or formatting constraints.
The source does not affect pasted-table structure or right-hand column containment.
